nodes.label: Thin slicing (value-flow relevance program slicing)
nodes.author: Manu Sridharan, Stephen J. Fink, Rastislav Bodik
nodes.rationale: Traditional slices grow too large for human consumption because Weiser's relevance definition is overly broad; thin slices keep only copy-propagating (value-flow relevant) statements, excluding base-pointer and control dependences, reducing inspected statements up to 4.52x for debugging and 34.2x for program understanding.
